annotations.title: Check an MCP server before connecting

description: Call before connecting to a remote MCP server, and whenever a call to it fails. Give url (any https URL of an MCP server; unknown ones are probed now) or id from an earlier answer. Returns alive, advice (ok / ok_requires_auth: working; unverified_yet: not fully checked yet; caution_tools_changed, caution_suspicious_tool_description: confirm with the user first; avoid_down, avoid_not_working_as_listed: do not connect), trust_score (0-100, open formula at https://alalanet.com/trust) with flags, checked_at, last_alive_at, uptime 24h/7d/30d, the tool-set diff (tools_diff, tools_changed_at), tool descriptions that look like hidden instructions (tool_description_flags), the digest of its initialize instructions, and on caution_* or avoid_* up to 3 working MCP servers on other hosts. Answers from recent checks (100 a day free); live=true probes now and adds a signed, logged attestation (5 a day free). Read-only for the caller; an unknown URL joins the public catalogue.

id.description: service id from an earlier answer; give either id or url

live.description: true: probe now and return a signed, logged receipt; false (default): recent checks

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server (private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

name: check_service
title: Check an MCP server before connecting
